title: 三脚式ポータブル投影スクリーン
description: 無地の不透明な投影面を一枚だけ展開した可搬式スクリーン。黒縁と黒い背面、上端バー、実際に開いたスリット付き収納筒、中央支柱、背面の斜めステー、三脚と折畳み風の補強リンクを備えます。白面は単色材質で、画像テクスチャ・透過・発光・映像表示はありません。巻取り・伸縮・脚は固定状態です。投影機、会場、床、人は含みません。巻取りばね、内部機構、細かなねじ山は省略。転倒安全性、構造、光学・投影性能は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）2.022 × 2.338 × 0.924 m、9,684三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A portable screen with exactly one extended blank opaque projection surface, black border and rear, top suspension bar, genuinely slotted cassette housing, center pole, rear diagonal stays, tripod feet and folding-looking brace links. The off-white face is a constant-color material, with no image texture, transparency, emission or displayed picture. Retraction, telescoping and legs are fixed. No projector, venue, floor or person is included. Roll-up spring, internal mechanisms and fine screw threads are omitted. Tip resistance, structural safety and optical/projection performance are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 2.022 × 2.338 × 0.924 m; 9,684 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
